_about: check-pan: two identical requests from the same caller arrive at the same moment. The first (request_id 'crm-pan-slow-A') places an IN_PROGRESS claim and starts the provider call. The second ('crm-pan-slow-B') sees the claim, waits up to 25 seconds, and replays the first's answer as soon as it finalises. This fixture shows the second request's response. See contract §7.2.
